upstream.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.

classification.analysis: Unsloth has grown from a fine-tuning acceleration library into a full local-first desktop app (Tauri-based Unsloth Desktop plus a web-based Unsloth Studio and a code-based Unsloth Core) for running, training, and deploying LLMs, diffusion, embedding, and audio models such as Kimi K3, Qwen3.8, DeepSeek-V4, Gemma 4, and FLUX. It supports 2x faster/70% less VRAM LoRA/QLoRA/full fine-tuning, RL (GRPO/DPO), GGUF/NVFP4/FP8 export, an OpenAI-compatible serving API, remote access via Cloudflare tunnels, and integration as a local model backend for Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents via MCP. It targets ML practitioners and hobbyists who want to fine-tune and self-host open models across CPU/NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon hardware.

use_cases.title: Fine-tune an open LLM with LoRA/QLoRA on consumer GPU hardware
Run a local desktop app to chat with and train open-weight models
Connect a locally fine-tuned model to Claude Code or Codex as a subagent
Export a fine-tuned model to GGUF or FP8 for deployment
